title: Siege of Maastricht (1673)
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Siege of Maastricht (1673)", at revision 1373343747, opens: "The Siege of Maastricht, 13 to 30 June 1673, took place during the Franco-Dutch War, when a French army captured the strategic Dutch fortress of Maastricht on the Meuse river." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q540121, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "French siege of Maastricht by Louis XIV during the Franco-Dutch War (1672–1678)". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
